$$
\begin{cases}
x = \rho \sin\phi \cos\theta \\
y = \rho \sin\phi \sin\theta \\
z = \rho \cos\phi
\end{cases}
$$
Substituting $\rho = 3$, $\theta = \frac{5\pi}{12}$, and $\phi = 0$:
- $x = 3 \cdot \sin(0) \cdot \cos\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right) = 0$
- $y = 3 \cdot \sin(0) \cdot \sin\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right) = 0$
- $z = 3 \cdot \cos(0) = 3$

$$
\boxed{(0, 0, 3)}
$$
